title: Source-trained gallery calibration under domain shift

rows.title: Source-trained gallery calibration under domain shift
rows.metric_summary: DTD to EuroSAT one-shot +0.4787 pp [0.3027, 0.6693]; reverse -1.4493 pp [-1.7160, -1.1679] versus source-selected controls; same-mass prediction differences 0.
rows.result_summary: Source calibration fails the prespecified bidirectional gate; estimates collapse toward 0 or 1 and no composition benefit is established.
rows.impact_summary: Auxiliary exposed-development evidence; not independent-domain confirmation, canonical Pets evaluation, or a general failure theorem.
rows.setup_note: Separate calibrators trained on 100 source episodes per domain; 100 source-only control-selection episodes; 500 evaluation tasks per target/support count, shared across two gallery sources.
